metadata.goal: Read a changelog markdown file and produce a concise release summary highlighting breaking changes and new features, written to output/ as a markdown file
metadata.platform_note: Tier 1d (Codex CLI): agents are TOML files with per-step model and model_reasoning_effort fields. dispatch_mechanism is model_driven. No Task() primitive. sandbox_mode controls reviewer isolation.

steps.description: Reads the changelog markdown file, extracts breaking-change and new-feature entries per version, writes structured JSON entries to the temp directory.
Reads extractor entries, renders a concise markdown release summary with breaking changes and new features sections, writes the final output file.
